author: DennisKoshta
attribution: The merged submissions disclose informal proofs and Rocq formalizations produced with Claude Code. Dennis directed the work, submitted contributions and performed the review described in individual PRs. The proof checker and upstream framework establish the formal results.
scope: These are proofs for individual six-state machines, not a computation of BB(6). The approximately 1.77e44 step count in PR 18 is computed outside Coq; only halting is proved.
